text: Follow-up (after 102.001-T lands): update the upstream spike/SKILL.md.tmpl in the external autoharness repo so regeneration preserves the in-repo docline findings-artifact fix (Principle IV, no out-of-tree writes). Refs: 102.001-T, 102-F, docs/exec-plans/2026-07-13-spike-findings-docline-reconciliation-plan.md.

Normalize backlogit CLI created_at/updated_at timestamp emission to UTC (Z) across item artifact writers. Currently item artifacts (features/tasks/shipments) are written with a local offset while stash entries use UTC Z, producing mixed timestamp styles across .backlogit/ artifacts that can surprise sorting/auditing. Surfaced by PR #230 Copilot review. Scope: the item frontmatter writer(s) in internal/core / internal/models.

Add the missing top-level 'name:' frontmatter key to .github/skills/spike/SKILL.md so it matches the plugin/skills/spike/SKILL.md copy. Pre-existing inconsistency surfaced during 091-S review (not introduced by 091-S). Verify against plugin bundle structure expectations (TestPluginBundleStructurallyValid).

Add chunk_strategy: h1-h2-h3 and schema_version: '1.0' frontmatter keys to the four 091-S closure docline docs (docs/compound/2026-07-13-copilot-review-loop-convergence.md, docs/closure/2026-07-13-091-S-spike-docline-closure.md, docs/closure/2026-07-13-091-S-compound-refresh.md, docs/memory/2026-07-13/091-S-spike-docline-ship-memory.md) for ingestion consistency. docline lint passes without them (soft-convention keys); consider folding into a repo-wide doc-metadata backfill pass.
